summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AGI Inc., a Brazilian foreign private issuer. The filing attaches a press release announcing that Moody's Local upgraded Agibank's national credit rating from AA-.br to AA.br with a stable outlook, the first upgrade since the bank's February 2026 IPO. The filing contains no transaction, no change of control, no shareholder vote, no buyback or redemption, and no board restructuring. It is purely a routine disclosure of a credit-rating event. Under US-equivalent practice, this would correspond to a voluntary 8-K item 8.01. There is no special situation to categorize.
